body: One more thing. Quarkus code should be improved. A user shouldn't have to do any of this. Quarkus should not make it harder for tools like Byteman to be used with it. IOW Quarkus should hardcode byteman to be parent first class loaded.

issue.title: Update the classloading reference guide to mention fast-jar vs legacy-jar
issue.body:
Also, make byteman parent-first to allow advanced users to use byteman frictionlessly.
 
Closes: #29043
